outcome: Proportions of HLA-DR+ and CD38+ effector- and effector memory CD8 T cells
Proportions of HLA-DR+ activated T regulatory cells
Number of activated CD8 T cells
cohort: Healthy women in their 3rd trimester of pregnancy compared to healthy non-pregnant controls
finding: The proportions of HLA-DR+ and CD38+ effector- and effector memory CD8 T cells are significantly increased in the peripheral blood of pregnant women, and at the UPI, the proportion of HLA-DR+ activated T regulatory cells is significantly increased in proportion to activated CD8 T cells.
